positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- worked on the Desktop Client team on Microsoft Teams
- created a chromium-like task manager that shows app metrics such as CPU usage, memory usage, etc.
- learned how to use ReactJS, AngularJS, and Typescript to work across multiple repositories
- gained understanding of RxJS and Redux state container to implement a crucial part of the feature
- used Jasmine, Jest and Enzyme to write tests
- wrote a spec of the feature and presented to the architecture group and internally to my team
- finished my feature by the 10th week of the internship and released the feature internally to Microsoft Teams employees

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- worked on the Commerce + Ecosystems Commercial Experiences Group Marketplace team
- introduced software-as-a-service (SAAS) products to the Microsoft Store for Business website and the Microsoft 365 Admin Center
- customers can browse and purchase these SAAS products
- used Angular and Typescript to implement the feature as well as add additional front-end pages and back-end changes

positions.title: Explorer Intern
positions.description:
- experienced the complete software development cycle by working as both a program manager and a software developer
- designed and implemented a feature that allows employees of clients to send application purchase requests to their administrators on the Microsoft Store for Business website
- implemented the front-end UI using the Angular framework and Typescript
- made unit tests using the Jasmine framework
- added telemetry work to track customer usage of this feature
